gaps.sentence: There were three ___ (BURGLE) on our street last month.
gaps.explanation: 'Three burglaries' — plural noun for the crime; burglars are people.
'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.

gaps.sentence: His ___ (REFUSE) to cooperate stalled the negotiations.
He spoke ___ (CONFIDENT) in front of the camera.
The soup is a ___ (MIX) of herbs and spices.
gaps.explanation: 'A mixture of' — the noun for a blend.

gaps.sentence: Her ___ (ANALYSE) of the data took three weeks.
gaps.explanation: 'Analysis' is the noun for a detailed examination; an 'analyst' is a person.

gaps.sentence: The team's ___ (LOSE) came as a shock to the fans.
gaps.explanation: 'Their loss' — the noun for a defeat or disappearance.
